The '''Gerrard V military''' was the local defense force of [[Gerrard V]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], segments of the military, including [[General/Legends|General]] [[Camon Udeon]], staged an [[Uprising on Gerrard V|uprising]] on the planet, seizing the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harazod]].
